gloss: carrying over; putting off till later

definitions.gloss: carrying over (to a later time); postponement
definitions.explanation: Leaving a matter, a decision or a sum unsettled and carrying it over to a later time or occasion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The decision was carried over to the next meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{賞金|しょうきん}→賞金：14234_shoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}しだ。
examples.english: Nobody won, so the prize money rolls over to the next draw.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎて、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Too many of this year's tasks are being carried over, which makes it hard to plan next year.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be carried over to ~
- ⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}し: deferral of a decision
- ⟦{決着|けっちゃく}→決着：13251_kecchaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|も}ち{越|こ}し: the outcome is left undecided (in sports reports)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繰|く}り{越|こ}し→繰り越す：31803_kurikosu⟧: carrying over a balance or figure in accounts; {持|も}ち{越|こ}し is carrying over a matter or decision
- ⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧: postponing a scheduled event to a later date
